# FM200-System.com

> > Professional fire suppression systems and equipment featuring FM200, CO2, foam bladder tanks, fire detection tubes, and inorganic fire roller curtains for industrial and commercial applications.

FM200-System.com is operated by Guangzhou Xingjin Fire Equipment Co., Ltd., a manufacturer specializing in gaseous fire suppression systems (FM200, CO2, FK-5-1-12, NOVEC 1230, HFC 227ea) and passive fire protection equipment including fire roller curtains and shutters. The company provides comprehensive fire safety solutions for industrial plants, commercial buildings, and specialized applications like engine compartments and server racks.

## Key Topics

- FM200 (Heptafluoropropane)
- Gaseous Fire Suppression
- Clean Agent Systems
- Fire Detection Tubes
- Inorganic Fire Roller Curtains
- CO2 Fire Suppression Systems
- Foam Bladder Tanks
- FK-5-1-12 / NOVEC 1230
- HFC 227ea
- Automatic Fire Suppression
- Fire Roller Shutters
- Industrial Fire Protection
- Guangzhou Xingjin Fire Equipment Co., Ltd.
- Commercial Building Fire Safety
- Super Inorganic Fabric
